verdict.rationale: Whether a government agency's online service publishes its source under an open license is a fair axis, since public-sector software can be open-sourced. The evidence pack has no repository, license, or source-code disclosure. It only describes the My DOR filing portal, which sits behind an authenticated login wall, so there is no support for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
